baseline_models.mechanism: The temporal hinge makes unproductive ground a before-and-after field: divine rain-growth restores fertility after a dead interval.

activation_trace.role: Rain-fed growth supplies the concrete restoration enacted by the verb.
Yielding soil supplies the receptive material whose condition changes.
Temporal succession makes death a prior phase rather than a final identity.
Unworked, unusable land gives death an agricultural state rather than mere organismal cessation.

changed_reading.before: A bare assertion that life follows death.
changed_reading.after: An observable material reversal in which an unproductive substrate regains growth and yield.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The command-to-know and clarified-signs-to-reason sequence at words 1 and 9-13.
baseline_models.mechanism: Disclosure, clarification, visible marking, and reason form an epistemic chain; the land event is evidence designed to restrain uncomprehending perception.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to a knower initiates the demanded recognition.
Making meaning plain turns the natural event into articulated evidence.
A visible marker makes the reversal point beyond itself.
Understanding that checks ignorance supplies the intended human uptake.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports what happens to soil.
changed_reading.after: It commands disciplined recognition of the soil's reversal as a deliberately clarified sign.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The juxtaposition of death at word 7 with life at word 4 and reasoning at word 13.
baseline_models.mechanism: Branch senses permit the ground to figure a dormant faculty: loss of understanding is death, while restored benefit and restraint are life.

activation_trace.role: Intellectual deadness opens a cognitive rather than only agricultural death-state.
Restored benefit lets life denote regained efficacy.
Reason's checking function identifies the faculty whose efficacy returns.

changed_reading.before: Only literal ground passes from barrenness to growth.
changed_reading.after: A human capacity for useful, restrained understanding may also be the ground brought back to life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately adjacent heart passage gives the agricultural reversal an interior target: dormant-ground humility opposes a heart made dry and hard, so revivification models renewed receptivity.

activation_trace.role: A low, dormant-ground image bridges the requested heart response to the focus land.
The repeated heart names the human substrate undergoing or resisting change.
Loss of heart-softness supplies the interior analogue of dead ground.
Renewed growth supplies the reversal of that hardened condition.
Dead understanding makes the heart-land transfer lexically available.

structural_cues: 57:16 ends with hardened hearts; 57:17 immediately begins with a command to know.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: 57:16 juxtaposes desired heart-humility and actual hardening. Reader arrow: the dormant-ground and hardness branches make divine land-revival a model for renewed receptivity. Live alternative: 57:17 remains an agricultural resurrection proof without a heart referent.

changed_reading.before: The inner-ground reading is only a form-distant focus possibility.
changed_reading.after: The dead earth becomes a strong adjacent analogue for hearts hardened by delay yet still capable of renewed response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier clear-signs purpose clause defines revelation as extraction from darkness into light; the focus repeats clarification and signs, allowing explanation itself to function as enlivening movement.

activation_trace.role: Explicit clarification links the earlier signs to the focus act of making signs plain.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the directional rescue performed by the signs.
Illumination supplies the destination of that cognitive movement.
The focus clarification carries the earlier transformative function forward.
Life as restored benefit recasts illumination as effective renewal.

structural_cues: 57:9 and 57:17 share the clarified-sign cluster; 57:9 adds the explicit movement from darkness to light.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: clear signs in 57:9 move people from darkness to light, and 57:17 repeats sign-clarification. Reader arrow: that extraction and land-revival are parallel descriptions of enlivening cognition. Live alternative: they are separate metaphors joined only by revelation vocabulary.

changed_reading.before: Clarified signs merely describe an external revival.
changed_reading.after: Receiving the clarified signs is itself a revival: concealed, ineffective cognition is brought into useful light.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later repeated command narrates the same rain-growth field through drying and debris; first greening is real but cannot by itself signify durable life or final success.

activation_trace.role: The repeated demand for recognition marks the later plant cycle as a deliberate qualification.
Descending rain supplies the same life-enabling input implied by the focus revival.
Growth emerging from earth supplies the attractive but temporary life phase.
Drying and yellowing reverse the apparent endpoint of greening.
Perishable debris makes worldly flourishing explicitly nonfinal.
The focus growth image is retained while its temporal scope is narrowed.

structural_cues: 57:20 repeats the command to know and then sequences rain, growth, drying, and debris.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: 57:20 repeats the recognition command and supplies a complete vegetal rise-and-fall. Reader arrow: the later cycle qualifies the focus greening as provisional rather than final life. Live alternative: 57:20 may critique only worldly display, leaving 57:17 wholly affirmative.

changed_reading.before: Revival is an unqualified positive terminus.
changed_reading.after: Initial greening is a sign, not the destination; life must be judged beyond the next drying cycle.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately following loan-multiplication chain gives fertility a social analogue: released wealth becomes charitable seed, returns increased, and culminates in a reward whose branch inventory itself carries good vegetation and rain.

activation_trace.role: Material charity supplies the human input placed into circulation.
A parted asset or deed awaiting return supplies the seed-like release-and-return structure.
Increase by another like amount supplies the yield phase.
The good-growth and rain sense ties noble reward back to agricultural flourishing.
Life as benefit permits fertility to become socially useful action.
Productive ground supplies the yield template for multiplication.

structural_cues: 57:18 immediately follows the focus and repeats the loan-multiplication-reward chain already present in 57:11.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: charity, a returnable loan, multiplication, and a reward with a plant-linked branch follow the revived field. Reader arrow: this sequence maps fertility onto generative giving. Live alternative: adjacency may resume the spending theme without making giving a cultivation analogue.

changed_reading.before: The revived field demonstrates divine capacity but leaves human response unspecified.
changed_reading.after: Its yield logic becomes practical: enlivened understanding releases benefit through giving and multiplication.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because it checks the dominant softening model: the packet lets hard iron serve benefit when paired with balance and equity. It remains anchored in the focus senses of life as benefit and reason as restraint. Render only as a bounded counter-reading, not as a claim that the dead earth denotes iron or coercion.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The life-as-benefit sense at word 4 and reason's checking function at word 13.

activation_trace.role: Beneficial efficacy defines life broadly enough to test hard capacities by their use.
Reason as restraint supplies the boundary on force.
A justice-calibrating balance supplies governance of capacity.
Equity supplies the end toward which force is bounded.
Resistant hardness supplies a capacity that need not equal deadness.
Benefit distinguishes ordered hard capacity from destructive hardness.

changed_reading.before: Every hardness associated with death must simply be softened.
changed_reading.after: A living order may retain bounded hard capacity when reason, balance, and equity convert it to benefit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because it maps a later critique of invented practice onto cultivation. It remains anchored through the focus land-growth image and the later root's joined pasture and care branches. Render as a stewardship analogy; do not transfer the divine act of giving life to human technique.

activation_trace.role: Growth restored by rain supplies an initial renewal that can subsequently be tended.
Cultivable ground supplies the domain transferred to later practice.
Initiating something without a prior model supplies germination without guaranteed continuance.
Pasture-tending preserves the agricultural image inside the practice critique.
Sustained observance supplies the maintenance that mere initiation lacked.

changed_reading.before: Renewal is complete at the instant life first appears.
changed_reading.after: Initial revival opens a living process whose entrusted forms still require faithful tending.

strongest_changes: The adjacent hardened-heart passage turns dead-earth revival into a strong model of renewed receptivity.
The darkness-to-light purpose of clarified signs makes explanation itself an enlivening act.
The later rain-to-debris cycle qualifies first greening as provisional rather than final life.
The following charity-loan sequence converts fertility into a social logic of released and multiplied benefit.
summary.what_was_special: The dormant-earth branch under heart-humility creates an unusually exact soil-to-heart bridge, while the good-vegetation branch under noble reward extends the same field into charitable yield.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the heart-land transfer is intended as the primary local reading or as a powerful adjacent analogy.
Whether the charity sequence deliberately activates cultivation or only follows by thematic adjacency.
Whether bounded hardness and tended renewal should remain commentary-level counter-readings rather than enter synthesis.
